resources.string: Car data in the Vehicle app

Shows the car data Tarmac already reads, such as charge or fuel, range, odometer, tyres and outside temperature, in CarPlay’s Vehicle app. Read only: nothing goes to the car. Each value appears once a source on this head unit has given it: BYD ADB, the car data adapter or a TEYES head unit. Applies at the next connection.
Nothing yet. A value appears from the connection after a source on this head unit has given it: BYD ADB, the car data adapter or a TEYES head unit.

Answers CarPlay’s vehicle-state protocol. On head units with a climate source, the iPhone then shows the car’s climate in the dock and, with CarPlay Ultra chosen on the iPhone, in its Climate app; on TEYES and FYT units its Radio app plays the unit’s FM tuner. Also records what the iPhone sends in the diagnostic report. Reconnects CarPlay.
Climate comes from the %1$s CAN box. CarPlay shows it once the car has reported its climate.
This head unit has no climate source Tarmac can read, so CarPlay shows no climate controls.

Sends the iPhone’s temperature, fan, A/C, recirculation, defrost and seat-heating changes to the car through the %1$s CAN-box service, one step at a time. Tarmac checks the car’s answer after each step and stops sending at the first one the car does not take. Comfort functions only; the car’s own controls keep working. Applies at once.
Based on LIVI by Lasse Heitgres (https://github.com/f-io/LIVI)
